name: The Patient Portfolio
exposureNote: Illustrative ETF sector mixes, not current issuer data. Update from fund factsheets before relying on the 25% limit. Stock limits apply to direct positions; ETF overlap is not a security-level look-through.

holdings.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
holdings.thesis: Own the broad US market at low cost and let productive businesses compound.
holdings.risk: US equity drawdowns and large technology exposure.

holdings.name: Vanguard FTSE Developed Markets ETF
holdings.thesis: Diversify across developed economies outside the US with a low-cost index fund.
holdings.risk: Currency moves, foreign-market risk and prolonged US outperformance.

holdings.name: Vanguard Total Bond Market ETF
holdings.thesis: Use a diversified investment-grade bond allocation as a defensive counterweight.
holdings.risk: Interest-rate and credit risk; bonds can fall alongside stocks.

holdings.name: Microsoft
holdings.thesis: Recurring enterprise software and cloud demand support durable cash generation.
holdings.risk: High valuation, competition and heavy AI capital spending.

holdings.name: Johnson & Johnson
holdings.thesis: Diversified medicines and medical devices provide defensive earning power.
holdings.risk: Litigation, patent expirations and drug-development failures.

holdings.name: Berkshire Hathaway Class B
holdings.thesis: Insurance float and diversified operating businesses support disciplined compounding.
holdings.risk: Insurance losses, leadership transition and conglomerate complexity.

holdings.name: Procter & Gamble
holdings.thesis: Everyday brands and distribution scale support resilient cash flows.
holdings.risk: Private-label competition, input costs and premium valuation.

holdings.name: Union Pacific
holdings.thesis: An extensive rail network offers hard-to-replicate freight infrastructure.
holdings.risk: Economic sensitivity, labor costs and regulatory pressure.

holdings.name: Exxon Mobil
holdings.thesis: Integrated energy operations provide cash generation and some inflation sensitivity.
holdings.risk: Commodity-price cycles, capital intensity and transition risk.

holdings.name: NextEra Energy
holdings.thesis: Regulated utility earnings and power infrastructure add defensive exposure.
holdings.risk: Debt costs, regulation, storms and project execution.

holdings.name: Home Depot
holdings.thesis: Scale and professional-customer relationships support long-run home improvement demand.
holdings.risk: Housing weakness, consumer retrenchment and expensive entry prices.
